profile.name: Yoctopuce通用传感器接口
profile.description: 这是一个面向 Yoctopuce 各类传感器的通用软件接口，而不是单一实体仪器。它用于统一读取传感器测量值、单位、原始值、最小/最大值，配置记录频率与定时上报，访问历史数据，并管理校准点与数据记录功能，适合在实验系统中对不同 Yoctopuce 传感器进行通用接入。
profile.description_en: This is a generic software interface for Yoctopuce sensors rather than a single physical instrument. It is used to read sensor values, units, raw values, minimum/maximum values, configure logging and timed reporting, access recorded data, and manage calibration points and data logging across different Yoctopuce sensor types in laboratory setups.

registry.description: The YSensor class is the parent class for all Yoctopuce sensor types
